title: The Copper Clock
author: Oscar Joubert
blurb: Odile Lockridge, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, has spent five years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
